acquisition.method: Read and parse the complete GitHub MCP job log saved by the parent agent; compare all TypeScript diagnostic records and all guard records.

normalization: Strip GitHub timestamp and ANSI color prefixes.
For TypeScript diagnostics remove the GitHub ##[error] annotation prefix.
Compare path, line, column, TS code, first message and all indented continuation lines.
Compare each GATE/WARN record by level, location, rule and full message; treat identified timeout line moves separately.
method.diagnostic_scope: Only the actual Sucafina typecheck step. Indented diagnostic continuations are included; later workflow annotations and step metadata are excluded.
method.artifact_pins: Product SHA, tree, guardBase and mergeBase were read from source.json printed by this job; artifact ID, size and digest were read from its successful upload output.
